main_text.p: riati adulatores Papicolæ, quibus propheta Dei sanctus maledixit, dicens: Væ qui dicitis malum bonum, & bonum malum, ponentes tenebras lucem, &c. Esa.5. Ea enim quæ ad Christianæ religionis dignitatem pertinere Stella in hoc Iulio arbitrabatur, ad Satanæ monarchiam & æternæ perditionis regnum horribiliter spectare dignoscuntur. Et revera curiosò illa circumspexit animo Iulius, imuerecundus Antichristus, ac bellator iniquissimus, ut Stellæ verba profequar. Miram quoque pietatem, eius immanem tyrannidem assentator & hypocrita nominat: prudentiam astum, sapientiam dolum, consilium fraudem. Taliq; pontifice ac nauclero Ecclesiam indigere pronunciat, qui Petri naviculam ad salutis portum redigere posset: ac si horribilium uitiorum omnium sentina, Ro-mana synagoga & Babylonica meretrix, ea ipsa esset in mysterio cymba, ac fordidissimus Iulius Christus ipse. Multo rectius de hoc incarnato diabolo Vuicelius, æstimator alioqui iniquus, sentit: Martiquam Christo deditiorem illum fuisse conteftans. Eius impudentissima facta in Appendicibus maioris nostri operis lectori uidenda se offerunt. De eius insania dum iret ad bellum, proiectus in Tiberim D. Petri clauibus, sic scribit inter alios Philippus Melanchthon:

page.notes: Sheet is set in roman with italic passages; Greek or black letter not present. Long s rendered as s throughout. The marginal reference mark "#" in the left margin is a printer's mark, not transcribed. Underlining in the scan is a later reader's marking, not printed; not transcribed. Words "Stella", "Papicolæ" and similar are as printed; "spectare" is printed as "fpectare" and rendered as in the scan, with uncertainty: "spectare" read as "spectare". Line "Cum" at the foot is the start of a catchword-like word on the last line, given as paragraph because it is a full line, not a catchword. Possible printing errors: "Iulius" for "Iulius" and "Christus ipse" kept as printed.
